name: page-detail-screens
goal: Page details show concise identity, fixed page screenshots and viewport controls without scenario/state selectors or a commit action; every tab is captured

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Page detail keeps concise identity and viewport controls; every page tab has screenshots and inherited proof retains its origin.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Standard entity preview tests checked placement but not excess copy or controls; unit coverage lacked validated inherited captures. Extend those tests across every viewport.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Final frozen baseline 7566e18d, red afebe46d: concise overview, declared preview and usable inherited-image assertions fail. Complete final test corpus is frozen.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Opus 5.5 removed repeated page copy and selectors. Fixed previews reach both callers; validated unchanged screenshots retain their capture origin.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged final test corpus passes at d5e01b0e: 15 unit assertions and all 3 desktop/tablet/mobile browser cases, including every page tab. Green 533b20d6 pairs with red afebe46d at 7566e18d.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Local feature proof passes: 15 units, 3 browser cases across all seven tabs, 604-test complete Reports check, actual page walkthrough and nine original-byte checks. Root aggregate fails the unchanged baseline entityMeasure/entityShown definition guard; legacy integration has three pre-existing selector/fixture failures (16 pass, 4 unrun). Verification remains pending; no main merge, publication or native acceptance.
